_game_note: The 'game' block is what the mission actually uses. 3U stays exactly as the balanced baseline (4 kg and $120k, inside the table's ranges). mass_limit_kg uses the table's older-rule figures (1.33 / 4 / 8). launch_cost_k is inside each size's range (3U kept at the baseline). The bus mass scales with the mass limit (placeholder rule); the bus cost is not changed. Dimension, power range and downlink are shown on the briefing for information only: wiring downlink needs ground-contact minutes per day, which is not verified yet.
